# ISO 19115 to CDIF Discovery crosswalk

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_crosswalk_docs.py from crosswalk/iso19115.py
and crosswalk/codata.py. Do not edit by hand: change the code and
regenerate. -->

This crosswalk converts ISO 19115 metadata records, as published by
GeoNetwork catalogues, into JSON-LD that follows the [CDIF Discovery
profile](https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.1) (version 1.1). It reads two
XML encodings:

- **ISO 19115-3** (namespace `mdb` 2.0), the encoding of ISO 19115-1:2014.
  TERN, IMOS/AODN and AuScope publish nearly all their records this way.
- **ISO 19139** (namespace `gmd`), the encoding of ISO 19115:2003.

The rules follow CODATA's crosswalk spreadsheet
(`doc-corediscovery/archive/metadataCrosswalksCDIF-DCAT-ISOetc.xlsx`, sheet "crosswalks"). Each rule below gives the
spreadsheet rows it is based on and says where this tool departs from
them. The spreadsheet is an archived working document, not a normative
part of CDIF.

Only records that describe data are converted, because CDIF Discovery
describes datasets. Accepted resource scopes (`MD_ScopeCode`):
`collectionSession`, `dataset`, `dimensionGroup`, `fieldSession`, `model`, `nonGeographicDataset`, `productionSeries`, `series`, `tile`. A record with no
scope is treated as a dataset. Other scopes, such as `service`, are
reported as out of scope.

## Using it

- From an MCP client: `crosswalk_iso19115(url=...)` or
  `crosswalk_iso19115(example=...)`, and
  `crosswalk_geonetwork_record(catalogue=..., uuid=...)`. Each converts
  the record and validates the result against the CDIF JSON Schema and
  SHACL rules.
- From Python: `crosswalk.crosswalk(xml_bytes)` returns
  `{"record": ..., "report": ...}`.

The report says what was done, so that nothing is hidden:

- `mapped`: the CDIF properties produced, with the ISO elements they were
  copied from.
- `inferences_and_fallbacks`: every value that was inferred or taken
  from a fallback source.
- `missing_required`: CDIF required properties the ISO record cannot
  supply.
- `unmapped`: ISO sections the crosswalk ignored.
- `out_of_scope`: why a record was not converted (only when it was not).

### `@id`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/MD_Identifier/code`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/*/code`
- **Rule:** The DOI (as https://doi.org/...) or, failing that, the first http(s) identifier; else the landing page; else urn:uuid of the metadata identifier when it is a UUID; else '#resource'.
- **CODATA rows:** 2

### `schema:identifier`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/MD_Identifier`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/*`
- **Rule:** Primary identifier as schema:PropertyValue (propertyID from codeSpace; DOIs get propertyID 'https://doi.org'). If the resource has no identifier, the metadata identifier is used and the report says so.
- **CODATA rows:** 2

### `schema:sameAs`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/MD_Identifier`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/identifier/*`
- **Rule:** All other resource identifiers.
- **CODATA rows:** 44

### `schema:name`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/title`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/title`
- **Rule:** Text.
- **CODATA rows:** 3

### `schema:alternateName`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/alternateTitle`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/alternateTitle`
- **Rule:** Text.
- **CODATA rows:** 45

### `schema:description`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/abstract`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/abstract`
- **Rule:** Text; embedded HTML markup is removed.
- **CODATA rows:** 4

### `schema:version`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/edition`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/edition`
- **Rule:** Text.
- **CODATA rows:** 8

### `schema:dateCreated`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=creation]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=creation]`
- **Rule:** ISO 8601 as given.
- **CODATA rows:** 5

### `schema:datePublished`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=publication]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=publication]`
- **Rule:** ISO 8601 as given.
- **CODATA rows:** 7

### `schema:dateModified`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=revision|lastUpdate]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/date/CI_Date[dateType=revision|lastUpdate]`
- **Rule:** Latest revision date. If there is none, falls back to the metadata record's revision date, then publication, then creation date; the report says which was used.
- **CODATA rows:** 6
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA uses dateType lastUpdate only. GeoNetwork records use revision for the same purpose, so both are read. The fallbacks to metadata, publication and creation dates are this tool's.

### `schema:inLanguage`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/defaultLocale/PT_Locale/language`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/language`
- **Rule:** Language code.
- **CODATA rows:** 52

### `schema:creator`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=author|coAuthor|originator]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=author|coAuthor|originator]`
- **Rule:** Ordered @list of Person/Organization. Individuals within an organisation become Persons affiliated with it. If there is no author or originator, principalInvestigator is used.
- **CODATA rows:** 11
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA lists editor among the creator roles (row 11) but also maps editor to a contributor Role (row 23); this tool follows row 23. Using principal investigators when there is no author or originator is this tool's addition.

### `schema:publisher`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=publisher]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=publisher]`
- **Rule:** First publisher.
- **CODATA rows:** 22
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA maps publisher to a contributor Role. The CDIF schema has schema:publisher, which this tool uses.

### `schema:contributor`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty, identificationInfo/*/pointOfContact`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty, identificationInfo/*/pointOfContact`
- **Rule:** Every other role, as schema:Role with roleName a DefinedTerm from the ISO CI_RoleCode code list. Duplicates are removed.
- **CODATA rows:** 12, 23, 25

### `schema:provider`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `distributionInfo//distributorContact`
- **ISO 19139:** `distributionInfo//distributorContact`
- **Rule:** Distributors.
- **CODATA rows:** none
- **Differs from CODATA:** Not in CODATA's crosswalk. Distributor contacts map naturally to schema:provider, which the CDIF schema defines.

### `schema:funding`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=funder|sponsor]`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/citedResponsibleParty[role=funder|sponsor]`
- **Rule:** schema:MonetaryGrant with the party as schema:funder.
- **CODATA rows:** 26
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA also maps MD_Identification/credit. Credit is free-text acknowledgement, so it is left unmapped rather than turned into a MonetaryGrant.

### `schema:keywords`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/descriptiveKeywords/MD_Keywords, identificationInfo/*/topicCategory`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/descriptiveKeywords/MD_Keywords, identificationInfo/*/topicCategory`
- **Rule:** DefinedTerm when the keyword has an Anchor URI or a thesaurus (inDefinedTermSet = thesaurus URL, else its title); otherwise a string. Topic categories are DefinedTerms in the ISO MD_TopicCategoryCode list.
- **CODATA rows:** 13, 15

### `schema:spatialCoverage`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/extent/EX_Extent/geographicElement`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/extent/EX_Extent/geographicElement`
- **Rule:** Bounding box -> Place with GeoShape box 'S W N E'. Bounding polygons -> Place with a WKT (Multi)Polygon in CRS84 via geosparql:hasGeometry, plus their envelope as a box. Geographic description codes -> Place name.
- **CODATA rows:** 16

### `schema:temporalCoverage`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/extent/EX_Extent/temporalElement`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/extent/EX_Extent/temporalElement`
- **Rule:** ISO 8601 interval 'start/end'; an open or 'now' end is '..'.
- **CODATA rows:** 17

### `schema:license`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/resourceConstraints/*`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/resourceConstraints/*`
- **Rule:** Licence URIs from any constraint type: reference citation links, Anchors, URLs in text, Creative Commons licence-button images, and Creative Commons names in text (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0'). Creative Commons URIs are normalised. Inferred licences are noted in the report.
- **CODATA rows:** 18
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA reads reference/CI_Citation, or useLimitation text, in MD_LegalConstraints. NCRIS records also state licences in generic MD_Constraints and only as licence-badge images, so every constraint type is read and licences are also recognised from Creative Commons names and badges (reported as inferences).

### `schema:conditionsOfAccess`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/resourceConstraints/*/(useLimitation|otherConstraints)`
- **ISO 19139:** `identificationInfo/*/resourceConstraints/*/(useLimitation|otherConstraints)`
- **Rule:** Text statements, deduplicated.
- **CODATA rows:** 19, 20
- **Differs from CODATA:** Also reads MD_Constraints, not only MD_LegalConstraints.

### `schema:url`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/citation/CI_Citation/onlineResource, metadataLinkage`
- **ISO 19139:** `dataSetURI`
- **Rule:** Landing page: the citation's online resource; else the DOI; else the metadata linkage (the catalogue page).
- **CODATA rows:** 34
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA uses transfer options with function 'information'. NCRIS records give that function to many links that are not landing pages (home pages, THREDDS catalogues), so this tool uses the citation link that is labelled as a landing page or contains the record's identifier, then the DOI, then the catalogue page.

### `schema:distribution`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `distributionInfo//transferOptions//onLine/CI_OnlineResource`
- **ISO 19139:** `distributionInfo//transferOptions//onLine/CI_OnlineResource`
- **Rule:** Download protocols/functions -> DataDownload (contentUrl). OGC, ESRI, OPeNDAP and THREDDS protocols -> WebAPI with serviceType and a GET EntryPoint. Other links go to schema:relatedLink.
- **CODATA rows:** 33, 71-74
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA classifies links by function = download. GeoNetwork records rely on the protocol (e.g. WWW:DOWNLOAD-1.0-http--download, OGC:WMS-1.3.0-http-get-map), so the protocol is used first. CODATA's WebAPI rows give no ISO source; this tool builds WebAPIs from OGC, ESRI, OPeNDAP and THREDDS protocols, and fills the required termsOfService from the resource licence.

### `schema:relatedLink`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `identificationInfo/*/additionalDocumentation, distribution links`
- **ISO 19139:** `distribution links`
- **Rule:** LinkRole: 'describedby' for documentation, 'related' for other links.
- **CODATA rows:** 30, 55
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA maps associatedResource, which is not implemented yet (see below). Additional documentation and non-download transfer links are this tool's additions.

### `schema:variableMeasured`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `contentInfo/MD_CoverageDescription//attribute/*`
- **ISO 19139:** `contentInfo/MD_CoverageDescription/dimension/*`
- **Rule:** PropertyValue: name, propertyID (Anchor URI, e.g. NERC P01), unitText and unitCode.
- **CODATA rows:** 35, 75, 76
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA maps the ISO 19110 feature catalogue. This tool reads coverage descriptions (MD_SampleDimension, MD_Band), which is where IMOS records list their variables with NERC vocabulary URIs.

### `prov:wasGeneratedBy`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `resourceLineage/LI_Lineage`
- **ISO 19139:** `dataQualityInfo/DQ_DataQuality/lineage/LI_Lineage`
- **Rule:** prov:Activity with the lineage statement as description; lineage documentation becomes prov:used CreativeWorks.
- **CODATA rows:** 69
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA also maps the lineage statement to measurementTechnique of a variable (row 64). A record-level statement is not about one variable, so here it describes the generating Activity.

### `schema:subjectOf`

- **ISO 19115-3:** `metadataIdentifier, metadataLinkage, dateInfo, contact`
- **ISO 19139:** `fileIdentifier, dateStamp, contact`
- **Rule:** CatalogRecord node: @id from the metadata linkage or source URL, sdDatePublished from the metadata date, maintainer from the metadata contact, conformsTo CDIF core and discovery.
- **CODATA rows:** 38-42, 49
- **Differs from CODATA:** CODATA maps metadata dates to subjectOf dateModified and dateCreated; the CDIF schema's subjectOf has sdDatePublished, which is used instead.

## Results on NCRIS facility records

The 10 bundled records from the TERN, IMOS/AODN and AuScope GeoNetwork catalogues (see `tests/fixtures/iso/`), converted and checked with the MCP server's validator (CDIF JSON Schema and SHACL rules). SHACL counts include results on the catalog record.

| Record | Dialect | CDIF | SHACL violations / warnings / info | Missing required | Inferences |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tern-awra-canopy-conductance.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 6 / 11 | none | 2 |
| `tern-cmrset-evapotranspiration.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 4 / 9 | none | 1 |
| `tern-bat-acoustic-usa.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 5 / 4 | none | 2 |
| `aodn-glider-yamba.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 11 / 10 | none | 4 |
| `aodn-ran-ctd-profiles.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 7 / 10 | none | 5 |
| `aodn-sst-l3s.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 4 / 4 | none | 6 |
| `auscope-rosebery-3d-model.xml` | iso19115-3 | valid | 0 / 7 / 7 | none | 3 |
| `auscope-calperum-czo.xml` | iso19115-3 | **not valid** | 0 / 5 / 2 | none | 2 |
| `auscope-gsv-mineral-occurrences.xml` | iso19139 | **not valid** | 2 / 6 / 5 | schema:license or schema:conditionsOfAccess | 3 |
| `auscope-gsnsw-wms-service.xml` | iso19139 | out of scope: Resource scope is 'service' | | | |

Why the records that fail do so:

- `auscope-calperum-czo.xml`: its funder has no identifier, and CDIF's validation frame drops such funders (problem 2 below).
- `auscope-gsv-mineral-occurrences.xml`: the source record states no licence or access conditions, so CDIF's required `schema:license` or `schema:conditionsOfAccess` cannot be filled (a real gap in the source).

### Inferences and fallbacks

How often each was needed, across the 9 converted records:

| Records | Inference or fallback |
| --- | --- |
| 6 | The resource has no identifier; schema:identifier is the metadata record identifier. |
| 5 | @id is the schema:url value (no resolvable resource identifier). |
| 5 | No resource revision date; schema:dateModified is the metadata record's date. |
| 3 | schema:url is the catalogue's metadata page (no landing page or DOI). |
| 2 | WebAPI termsOfService is the resource licence or access conditions (ISO has no per-service terms). |
| 1 | A bounding box crosses the antimeridian (west > east); kept as given. |
| 1 | A funder has no identifier. CDIF's validation frame only embeds funders that have schema:identifier, so the JSON Schema check will report schema:funder as missing although it is present. |
| 1 | DOI taken from an online resource link (e.g. protocol 'DOI'), not from the citation identifiers. |
| 1 | No author or originator; principal investigators used as creators. |
| 1 | No resource scope (MD_ScopeCode) given; treated as dataset. |
| 1 | No usable identifier for @id; used '#resource'. |
| 1 | WebAPI distributions have no termsOfService: the record states no licence or access conditions. |

## Problems found in CDIF itself

Building the crosswalk exposed three problems in the CDIF artefacts. They
affect any CDIF producer, not only this one.

1. **Invalid JSON-LD for WKT geometry.** The CDIF JSON Schema, and
   `exampleCDIFDiscoveryComplete.json`, give `geosparql:asWKT` an array
   `@type`. JSON-LD 1.1 requires a value object's `@type` to be a single
   IRI, so JSON-LD processors reject the example (pyld: "invalid typed
   value"). This crosswalk writes a string `@type`, which is valid
   JSON-LD.
2. **Funders without identifiers are dropped by the validation frame.**
   In `CDIFDiscoveryDoc-frame.jsonld`, the `schema:funder` sub-frame lists
   only `schema:identifier`. JSON-LD framing then matches only funders
   that have an identifier, so a funder known only by name disappears
   from the framed document, and the JSON Schema reports `schema:funder`
   as missing although it is present.
3. **Dataset rules also apply to the catalog record.** CDIF types the
   metadata record in `schema:subjectOf` as `schema:Dataset`, so the
   SHACL Dataset recommendations (creator, description, keywords...) are
   also checked on it. The MCP server's `validate_cdif` reports these
   separately, as `catalog_record_results`, so that they are not read as
   gaps in the dataset.
